notes: The report gives only aggregate DRC figures (no individual case records), so no individual new_cases or outcome_updates can be created; the existing line list is empty. Aggregate DRC figures as of 10 June 2026: 676 confirmed cases, 136 deaths (CFR 20.1%), 32 recovered, 16 confirmed among health and care workers, 161 additional confirmed cases and 45 additional confirmed deaths since 8 June (partly due to backlog testing). Ituri accounts for 629 confirmed cases (109 deaths), North Kivu and South Kivu for the rest; 29 health zones affected. Contacts: 5768 under follow-up (Ituri 4703, North Kivu 841, South Kivu 224); 4141 followed up. No suspected-case total is stated for the DRC. Uganda figures were excluded per the country filter. The report is the WHO DON dated 13 June 2026.
